Chapters.Name: Stellar Frontier
Chapters.Description: The edge of known space. Establish your first line of defense.

Boss.Name: The Rift Devourer
Boss.Pattern: Rift pulse: a telegraphed pause before fortification. Keep firing.

Chapters.Name: Nebula Expanse
Chapters.Description: Read the currents. Adapt to fast and shielded enemy formations.

Boss.Name: The Nebula Warden
Boss.Pattern: Nebula shield: a brief, visible defense after each cast.

Chapters.Name: Ancient Celestial Ruins
Chapters.Description: Awaken the ruins. Hold your ground against ancient constructs.

Boss.Name: The Astral Colossus
Boss.Pattern: Ancient procession: reinforcements arrive once at half health.

Chapters.Name: Event Horizon
Chapters.Description: Where light bends. Watch the Finish and prepare for pressure.

Boss.Name: The Void Sovereign
Boss.Pattern: Horizon surge: a telegraphed burst of speed after casting.

Chapters.Name: Cosmic Singularity
Chapters.Description: The final fracture. Unite every lesson against the heart of the Void.

Boss.Name: The Entropy Architect
Boss.Pattern: Entropy convergence: shields, surges and one final reinforcement group.
